title: Nepal floods pose biggest test yet for UN climate loss and damage fund
title_zh: 尼泊尔洪水是联合国气候损失与损害基金面临的最大考验
abstract: Countries should not have to wait months to receive relatively small grants for responding to the immediate impact of extreme weather.
abstract_zh: 各国不应因应极端天气的即时影响而等待数月才能获得相对小额的拨款。
